# Supplied content H

Synthetic fixture. Editorial as-of date: 2026-11-16.
Draft: A report published this month describes a synthetic English API panel collected 1–14 February 2024. In that panel, 40 of 100 responses cited video sources. These historical observations do not establish the current rate.
Supplied study metadata: publication 2026-11-01; collection 2024-02-01 through 2024-02-14; 40/100 responses, English synthetic API. No later measurement is supplied.
studySources.scope: Synthetic English API panel; collection 2024-02-01 through 2024-02-14; 100 responses; publication 2026-11-01. Engine, model, prompts, market and brand are not supplied.
limitations: Synthetic fixture aggregate; not live or current brand visibility
Response-level records are not supplied; no individual responses are reconstructed
Historical observations do not establish the current rate; no later measurement is supplied
API panel results are not consumer-UI evidence
